description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies if 4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken King of Beasts] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Inundating Pummel Follow-Up] to the user if 0-3 FF11 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Awoken King of Beasts
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Water abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Inundating Pummel Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Inundating Pummel after using a Water ability
